product_one_liner.value: Formalize is a compliance operations platform that helps compliance, security, risk and privacy professionals connect and automate regulatory frameworks, controls, evidence, risks, incidents and supplier workflows.

named_customers.notes: Arcano Partners has a named case study; Coop appears on the customer-logo wall.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index contains compliance guidance and product/marketing content, not an engineering-authored publication about building the product.

public_docs.notes: Public help center contains multiple product guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board lists eight roles; none has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: No underlying model or model provider could be verified from the public IQ documentation, AI terms, AI blog and client privacy policy. The policy refers to a Trust Center subprocessor list that was not publicly retrievable.

compliance_certs.notes: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 is claimed for Formalize itself. Hosting-facility SOC 2 and PCI DSS scanning criteria are not treated as Formalize certifications; GDPR compliance is not a certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced October 28, 2025 as €30 million; the cited funding profile reports the round as US$34.95 million.

raised_18mo.notes: The October 28, 2025 Series B falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Sales Development Representative – Norway opening.

launched_6mo.notes: The new Audit module launched October 12, 2026; Formalize IQ is also recorded as launched October 7, 2026. Both fall within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Patrick Olsen announced his departure as CMO in January 2026, stating that the handover had finished in December 2025; this falls within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The SDR posting explicitly calls HubSpot “our CRM system.”
